description: This file contains a singleton object 'QiblaCalculator' that computes the initial bearing from a given geographic coordinate to the Kaaba, using spherical trigonometry formulas. It is part of a mobile app focused on Islamic prayer times and directions.

classes.name: QiblaCalculator
classes.description: Singleton object providing a method to calculate the bearing from any given latitude and longitude to the Kaaba for Islamic prayer direction.

methods.name: bearingToKaabaDegrees
methods.description: Calculates the compass bearing from a specified geographic coordinate to the Kaaba in degrees, ranging from 0 to 360.
